player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ta'a JoJoJoin irratti, booda 5x5 irratti kan maxxanfame 0-24 tiin.
Gurra kee, maxxansa kee bakka hundatti maxxanfame irratti maxxansi, fakkeenya '[12]'.
ATI MO'ATA maqaa arfii kee afur irratti wal qabata — arfii afur walitti aanee irraa gara, olii fi gadi, ykn kor-kora.
Akka Player {player_id} ta'e, ati '{symbol}' ta'a; kan si qabdu '{opponent_symbol}' ta'a.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tarkaanfiin dhiyaate bifa sirrii hin hordofne.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} seeliin sirrii miti. 0 fi 24 gidduutti ta'uu qaba.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} markii isaa ({symbol}) cellii {cell} keessatti seene.
